item.title: Top 4 Methods to Convert a Number Range While Maintaining Ratio
item.description:
When tackling the problem of converting a number from one range to another while maintaining the ratio, several effective methods can be employed, especially in programming environments like Python. This in-depth guide explores top solutions that ensure precision, handle boundary cases, and offer flexibility in input and output ranges.

Overview of the Problem

Given an original range of numbers, say from -16000 to 16000, and the desire to compress these values into a new range, such as 0 to 100, is a common task. The process should guarantee that each value retains its relative position in the new scale, even as some degree of precision is lost. It’s also essential to make the conversion process adjustable, allowing for any input and output range.
